question: X, Y and Z invested a sum in the ratio of 19 : 88 : 18, respectively. If they earned a total profit of ₹2,200 at the end of the year, what is the difference between the shares of Y and Z?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The total profit is distributed exactly in the ratio of the invested capitals.

Ratio of investments X : Y : Z = 19 : 88 : 18

Total parts in the ratio = 19 + 88 + 18 = 125 parts

Difference in parts between Y and Z = 88 − 18 = 70 parts

Difference in shares = (70 ÷ 125) × 2200 = 70 × 17.6 = 1232

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,232.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Investment ratio of X, Y and Z = 19 : 88 : 18

Total profit earned at the end of the year = ₹2,200

**Formula Used:**

Profit Share = (Individual Ratio ÷ Total Ratio) × Total Profit

 Total Profit = ₹2200 (125 parts)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total ratio = 19 + 88 + 18 = 125

⇒ Value of 1 ratio part = 2200 ÷ 125 = ₹17.6

⇒ Y's profit share = 88 × 17.6 = ₹1,548.8

⇒ Z's profit share = 18 × 17.6 = ₹316.8

⇒ Difference between the shares of Y and Z = 1548.8 − 316.8 = ₹1,232

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,232.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Profit Rule

When the time period of investment is the same for all partners, their total profit is distributed strictly in the ratio of their invested capitals. Profit Ratio = Capital₁ : Capital₂ : Capital₃.

Unequal Time Periods

If partners invest their money for different durations, the profit ratio is determined by the compound ratio of their capital and time period. Profit Ratio = (C₁ × T₁) : (C₂ × T₂).

Active and Sleeping Partners

An active partner manages the day-to-day business and usually receives a fixed salary or a certain percentage of the total profit before the remaining profit is distributed among all partners according to their investment ratio.
